name: Bloodmage: Dark Curse raises weapon and spell critical strike chance (#1996)
contract: Dark Curse 704649 (3%) and 560252 (6%): "Increases critical strike chance by $s1%." Each has a single effect, aura 290 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT, MiscValue 0 and an empty EffectSpellClassMask, handled by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:355), which for a player runs both UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras and UpdateAllSpellCritChances - exactly the unqualified "critical strike chance" the tooltip promises. This core ignores aura 290's misc value and class mask (.agents/docs/systems/ascension-spell-parity.md:333), which does not bite here because both records carry zero for both. No source or SQL change is involved.
